description: Na₃V₃O₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.71-2.77 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one O atom. The Na-O bond length is 2.21 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one O atom. The Na-O bond length is 2.22 Å. There are four inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing VO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.00 Å) and four longer (2.03 Å) V-O bond lengths. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 15°. There is one shorter (1.68 Å) and three longer (1.76 Å) V-O bond lengths. In the third V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing VO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.01 Å) and four longer (2.03 Å) V-O bond lengths. In the fourth V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-15°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.77 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two V atoms.
